summary: Iteration 14 — verified Devanagari/Bengali font fix, fit_audio_to_budget behavior, and Story Studio cast display. Created new pytest file with 7 focused tests; all pass. Regression suite (test_incremental_retry_and_segment.py, 7 tests) still green. Combined 13/13 backend tests passed. critical_code_review_comments: font_for_text() has a well-designed 3-tier fallback (hard-coded Noto paths → fc-match by lang → Latin fallback with WARN), avoiding load_default() for Indic scripts. Good.
fit_audio_to_budget() correctly only speeds UP (never slows), caps at 1.35x tempo for naturalness, and no-ops when cur <= budget+0.35. Errors are logged and non-fatal (returns original duration).
backend/services/media.py is 651 lines — still within acceptable range but approaching the 700-line split threshold; consider extracting audio helpers if it grows further.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded story 6ab5f14152ebe8f78807faf9 ('Arjun and the Bird'); no new seed data created. Test audio mp3s generated in tmp via ffmpeg inside pytest.
